name: Mold Rhymes With...

faq.answer: Krinkle Goodsteel is an artisan residing in the desert town of Gadgetzan.
Gadgetzan is a goblin settlement in the desert of Tanaris.

aliases: what to bring to krinkle goodsteel
faq.answer: You carry imbued skeletal fragments along with fifteen gold coins across the dunes to Krinkle Goodsteel.

sections.body: A specialized undertaking sends you across the dunes toward Gadgetzan. Krinkle Goodsteel awaits delivery of imbued skeletal fragments and fifteen gold coins to assist in his craft.
sections.title: Delivery to Gadgetzan

summary: You carry imbued skeletal fragments and fifteen gold coins across the sands to Krinkle Goodsteel in Gadgetzan. The smith awaits the payment and materials to assist in his specialized work.
